paragraphs.text: We are looking for a kitchen assistant for our restaurant near the station. Hours are 4 pm to 11 pm, four days a week including one weekend day. Experience is useful but not essential; training is given.
The pay is £11.50 an hour, rising to £12.20 after six months. Staff eat free on shift and receive a uniform. Applicants must be able to work until the end of the year; the post may become permanent.

items.quote: Experience is useful but not essential; training is given

explanation.en: Experience is useful but not essential → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Тәжірибе пайдалы, бірақ міндетті емес → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Опыт желателен, но не обязателен → FALSE.

items.quote: four days a week including one weekend day
items.prompt: The job includes work at the weekend.

explanation.en: One weekend day is a working day → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Аптасына бір демалыс күні жұмыс күні болады → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Один выходной день в неделю — рабочий → TRUE.

items.prompt: Pay increases after half a year.

explanation.en: The rate rises after six months → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Алты айдан кейін мөлшерлеме жоғары → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Через шесть месяцев ставка выше → TRUE.

items.quote: a kitchen assistant for our restaurant near the station
items.prompt: The restaurant is part of a chain.

explanation.en: Nothing is said about a chain → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Желі туралы ештеңе айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: О сети ничего не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
